```python
def max_sub(xs):
    n = len(xs)
    max_sum = xs[0]
    for i in range(1, n):
        xs[i] += max(xs[i], xs[i] + xs[i-1])
        max_sum = max(max_sum, xs[i])
    return max_sum
```

```python
def transpose(m):
```

```python
def hms(sec):
    hours = sec // 3600
    remainder = sec % 3600
    minutes = remainder // 60
    seconds = remainder % 60
    
    return '{:02d}:{:02d}:{:02d}'.format(hours, minutes, seconds)
`````
